p: Westgate Street is one of the main shopping streets leading off the Cornhill, the old market square with the Town Hall that sits bang in the middle of Ipswich. That puts MERKUR right among the high street chains, cafés and takeaways, and handy for the buses that run through the centre.

Remember it's adults only, 18+ with ID if you look young. If you're making a proper trip into town, Christchurch Park and Christchurch Mansion are a short stroll north, the Tudor plasterwork on the Ancient House in the Buttermarket is worth a look, and the Waterfront, with its marina and bars, is ten minutes' walk south. The New Wolsey Theatre on Civic Drive is close by for an evening out.
